free_tier.stated: Free plan: '5 GB storage' with 'Unlimited users - no team size limits'. Portals are free and self-service.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: No per-object cap is published on the pricing page or the free-plan page; the plan quota is a shared pool covering Drive, CRM files, call recordings and email attachments.

retention.stated: Retention: 'inactive Free accounts may be deleted after 40 days'. This is a documented data-loss clause and the binding constraint.
retention.notes: The free-plan blog states that inactive Free accounts may be deleted after 40 days; no other retention term is published for Drive files.

egress.terms: No egress meter on any plan; Drive files served from the portal. Not part of the pricing table.

tooling: Bitrix24 Drive mounts as a WebDAV network drive (documented for Windows/macOS); REST API also exposes disk.* methods. Third-party mounts exist (rclone via WebDAV, or OS-native WebDAV).
chaining: The free plan has no team-size limit and 5 GB of shared storage per portal; Drive mounts as a WebDAV network drive. No first-party page states a portal-count multiplier.

extras.quota_verbatim: Free plan: '5 GB storage' with 'Unlimited users - no team size limits'. Portals are free and self-service.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-object-cap: not published on the pricing page (Drive-specific cap unverified). Quota is per-portal, shared across Drive + CRM files + email attachments + call recordings — a mixed bucket. Retention: 'inactive Free accounts may be deleted after 40 days' — this is a documented data-loss clause and the binding constraint.
extras.egress_verbatim: No egress meter on any plan; Drive files served from the portal. Not part of the pricing table.
extras.chaining_verbatim: 5 GB x unlimited free portals, each with unlimited users. 100 portals = 500 GB. WebDAV means a plain `rclone copy` per portal — the most scriptable of the free-workspace KBs.

extras.agent_focus: Documentation and knowledge-base platforms with large attachment quotas — wiki farms, helpdesk KBs, docs hosts; whether per-workspace quotas multiply across free workspaces

binding_note: a clock, not a quota: bytes leave whether or not transfer is completed
